messages:
Arjun: LAN night idea 60; whos up for PC vs console next Saturday at the office? Could do Steam coop, Rocket League, Smash on the side.
Maya: Im in. Can we do Rocket League tournament? I want revenge from last time. :smirk: 
Devon: Count me in too. I can bring my PC + switch for Smash. Also have an extra monitor.
Ben: Id prefer something on Steam so I can play on my laptop. Any chance for a Left 4 Dead 2 coop run?
Arjun: Nice. Poll: what primary mode? 1) Rocket League 2) L4D2 coop 3) Smash side games 4) Open free-for-all. React with :one: :two: :three: :four:
Maya: :one: for Rocket League (Im bringing a controller)
Devon: :two: and :three: will work for me.
Ben: :two: L4D2 hype. Also can we do a Steam sale wishlist swap? Might be nice to coordinate buys/demos.
Arjun: Good call. Also logistics: well need surge protectors and at least two ethernet cables for real-time play. Who can bring spares?
Maya: I have a 10ft cat6 and a power strip.
Devon: Ill bring another cable + HDMI.
Ben: I can bring snacks and the spare controller. No alcohol this time pls (policy).
Arjun: Calendar created: "Office LAN Night 1: Rocket League + L4D2" Saturday 18:00 1:00. Attendees so far: Arjun, Maya, Devon, Ben.
